title: Prophets of Pop
description: You meet a musician in Natlan named Milu Nui, but he appears to have run into some trouble...

mainQuestExcel.title: Prophets of Pop
mainQuestExcel.description: You meet a musician in Natlan named Milu Nui, but he appears to have run into some trouble...

dialogs.text: Seriously, there's no getting through to Pakaa... He doesn't understand my musical ideals at all!
What happened?
Hmm? You're a... traveler? Greetings. Call me Milu Nui. I'm a musician.
If you've been to Xochicuicatl Records, you'll have seen my records in the pop music section.
They contain all that I understand of "pop" itself.
It's just that Pakaa doesn't understand me at all, and insists that my music resembles "kiddy music" more than it does "pop."
And no matter what I say, he wants my records placed in the children's section!
I mean, yes, children do like my songs, and some parents do buy them as gifts for their kids...
But in truth, children are the keenest listeners! And there's a lot of them in the tribe anyhow...
So if my records are so popular amongst the kids, I should have a spot in the pop section!
That... does make some sense...
Right? Hmph! I knew Pakaa was just being his usual ignorant self. But no more! Once I'm done writing this new song, he'll have no choice but to admit how impressed he is!
Not that I trust his taste in music anymore, though... Anyway, traveler, how familiar would you call yourself with music?
Uhh...
Do you play an instrument? It's fine if you just sing or hum!
I'm as musically versatile as they come.
Awesome! In that case, I'm sure you'll understand my philosophy of music!
Someone like you is exactly who I need if I'm to create this all-new jam.
Don't worry, I'll have a most ample reward ready — it'll be well worth your while.
Alright then. Just use your intuition, and tell me — what should I do first to create an excellent piece of music?
Not in the slightest...
No matter! Only someone like you can truly enjoy music from the heart. I'm sure your judgment will be all the more objective and fair for it.
You could consider it "children's pop."
And what are these musical ideals you speak of?
We should hear from customers first.
Well, that... I don't disagree, and I've actually made some inquiries myself...
But it feels like they just default to pleasantries when they see me, so I never get to hear their honest opinions.
#{NICKNAME}, could you help me ask around instead?
I imagine they'll... feel more comfortable being honest with you.

You could try gathering some sound samples...
Sounds...? Oh, do you mean to say that we could sample the sounds of nature and use them directly in the songs?
Hmm... That does sound like a good idea. Yes, very good indeed! See, I knew you were a sharp shovel! Come on, let's get going!
Wait, you're not bringing anything with you?
Of course not. Or are you expecting me to drag a gramophone around out there?
Don't worry, we're just going to see what sorts of sounds we can use.
A duck flapping its wings, for instance, or the splash made as a Koholasaurus hits the water, or the rumbling footsteps of a Tepetlisaurus walking...
Once we've selected out targets, I'll make the preparations to take those sound samples... but that's all for later.
As for the here and now, let's head out — time's a-wasting!
We should hear from customers first.

Pop... *sigh* What is pop, anyway?
And how are you going with your musical ideals?
#Ah, {NICKNAME}, a pleasure to see you again! As for my musical ideals, I can only say that... I'm hard at work seeking a breakthrough.
*sigh* But what sort of "pop" is everyone looking for, really? And how is "pop" supposed to feel?
#I know you're someone who appreciates music, {NICKNAME}.
So please, would you mind giving me some more suggestions based on your intuition? What should I do first to create an excellent piece of music?

flow.stepDescription: Go gather materials with Milu Nui

dialogs.text: Look at those birds, listen to their cries! My, oh my, if those wouldn't make excellent material for my next work!
Still, things could get pretty one-note if we only recorded a few of them. If we could find a whole flock and record the sound of their collective calls...
Hang on, that's a Koholasaurus just up ahead. You hear how it scratches the stone with its claws?
Koholasaurs are the sensitive sort, so let's not get too close. I'll get some professionals from our tribe to gather what I need afterward — if anyone can pull this off, it'd be them.
Oh, ho... warriors testing themselves against one another. Good, good, the sounds of battle are lovely indeed...
Oi! What're you skulking about for? You here for a fight?
We're just... gathering materials...
Gathering? Well, I'll show you "gathering"!
#H—Help! {NICKNAME}, stop him!
#Phew! You're quite the dab hand yourself, aren't you, {NICKNAME}?
You seem good at persuading the more agitated types...
That wasn't even my full power.
I could tell. In every possible aspect... it is quite obvious.
Well, that was quite the adventure, but either way, I've selected plenty of sounds to sample.
After just a bit of prep work, I'll be able to officially start recording the audio...
Hmm... We should start with the "sounds of battle"...
Wait, no. That's not a good place to begin. We should open up with something more normal...
I thought it went okay.
That's very modest of you. Thank you, in any case.

flow.stepDescription: Seek customer feedback in the shop

dialogs.text: Ooh, a new record! The baby Saurian's gonna love this!
Tell me about Milu Nui's music...
I love Uncle Milu's songs — and really, the baby Saurian we have back home loves them more than I do!
Whenever it gets too rowdy, Mom plays one of his songs, and then it quiets down real quick.
Hmm... Those songs are super long, though. I can barely remember the lyrics, let alone sing 'em for it...
Hehe, if he could write some songs with fewer lyrics, I'd be able to sing them every day for that kid's listening pleasure!
How did it go? Did they have any feedback?
I've heard these opinions...
You convey the customer feedback to Milu Nui...
A—Ah. Is that how things are? Thank you, the feedback is quite valuable. Let me see what I can change...
Still, from the sound of it... aren't they all treating my records like kids' songs!?
...No, no, all the more reason to make some changes... Still, where do I begin?
Pop... What is pop, anyway? Goodness...

flow.stepDescription: Seek customer feedback in the shop

dialogs.text: Mr. Milu's released a new record! Should I buy it or not...
Tell me about Milu Nui's music...
Hmm? Oh, he's great! Haloa and the baby Saurian love it.
Every time they get all rowdy and stubborn and don't wanna sleep, I'll play them Mr. Milu's "Spring-Day Song."
As soon as they hear it, they're asleep in no time — voila, sweet dreams, see you tomorrow.
Still, though... Haloa has been saying that she'd prefer something a bit more intense.
If Mr. Milu could come up with a couple of tunes with a bit more energy, I'm sure she'd have more fun with 'em.
